subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Stranger danger; adults learners trust and strangers who help us (police, nurses)

show.line: A stranger is someone we do not know. We stay with people we trust.

rounds.prompt: A stranger offers you sweets. What do you do?
rounds.praise: Say no, go to a grown-up you trust!

rounds.prompt: Who can help you if you are lost?
A stranger says, come with me. What do you say?
Someone you know and trust, or a stranger?

rounds.story: Bongi is lost at the shops. She cannot see mama. What should she do?
rounds.praise: Ask a shop worker or guard to help!

hints: Never go anywhere with someone you do not know.
Shout no, run away and tell a grown-up you trust.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! A stranger offers me a ride.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Yes please, I will get in the car!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Say no, run and tell a grown-up.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Say no! Run to a grown-up you trust!

parent_line: Knows to say no to strangers and find a trusted adult.
